messages.subject: erro copy number chrM.
parts:
Hi, I'm using Sequenza. But something went wrong, because out.seqz.gz, only contains data regarding the chromosome (chrM).
How can I use Sequenza for all chromosomes?

I used the following command lines:

samtools faidx ./hg19.fa

sequenza-utils gc_wiggle -f ./hg19.fa -w50 | gzip > hg19.gc50Base.txt.gz

sequenza-utils bam2seqz -gc hg19.gc50Base.txt.gz -n NORMAL.sorted.bam -t TUMORAL.sorted.bam --fasta ./hg19.fa | gzip >  out.seqz.gz

sequenza-utils seqz_binning -w 50 -s out.seqz.gz | gzip > out.small.seqz.bz


I also tried without success:


sequenza-utils gc_wiggle -w 50 --fasta hg19.fasta -o hg19.gc50Base.wig.gz

sequenza-utils bam2seqz -n NORMAL.bam -t TUMORAL.bam --fasta hg19.fasta \
-gc hg19.gc50Base.wig.gz -o seq.gz

sequenza-utils bam2seqz -n NORMAL.bam -t TUMORAL.bam --fasta hg19.fasta -gc hg19.gc50Base.wig.gz -o seq.gz
